question: Can frozen SOURCE FIT RGB reference banks be selected using original q8 RGB features without true query object identity, while retaining the oracle visibility rank signal?
prior_science: V249 oracle reference signal main de362d26e; not a deployable classifier or pallet accuracy. Original q8/context alone and same-image context cosines already existed.

selection_fixed.descriptor: Only full_CLS bank is compared with full96 NODE_CLS; never compare different descriptor definitions. Query scoring still reports all3 views.
selection_fixed.numeric: FP64 node and prototype unit-L2 then cosine; no fitted normalization or bank recomputation.
selection_fixed.node_support: original_available8 & node_available8 & finite nonzero fullCLS norm, omit active_slot. No target/state/S_U/owner filter.
selection_fixed.per_bank_aggregation: Mean of top2 valid other-node cosine scores. Node cosine ties use ascending slot. No random samples or K sweep.
selection_fixed.bank_choice: Max aggregate across all4 banks, exact bank-score ties choose lowest frozen bank index; no score/gap threshold. All4 fullCLS prototypes must be supported else selectorUNKNOWN; no silent bank removal.
selection_fixed.unknown: Fewer than2 valid othernodes or invalid fixed bank means UNKNOWN; retain all rows, no fill/negative.
selection_fixed.true_query_object_ID_role_state_qr_owner: Not selector API inputs. Source FIT class-labelled prototypes are legitimate frozen supervised assets; no true query ID lookup at inference.
selection_fixed.selector_gap: top bank score minus runnerup stored only, no threshold selected.

prediction_fixed.population: All original known YCB1521 rows selected using samples.family==1 only. No FIT/DEV or D/E selection before prediction freeze; no SYN visibility claim.
prediction_fixed.maps: Original SAMPLE_GROUP_INDEX/NODE_INDEX; unchanged group/slot/q/L. Require originalactive fullCLS bytes equal NODE_CLS[group,slot] for YCB rows.
prediction_fixed.query_scores: All3 fixed descriptor slices full_CLS0:384, fixed_centre_Q384:768, centre_CLS768:1152; unitL2 FP64, cosine selectedbank, cosine nextcyclicbank, margin selected-next. Other bank=(predicted_index+1)%4, no trueID lookup. Query unavailable/zero/nonfinite or absentreference yields UNKNOWN, never E.
prediction_fixed.outputs: 1521 selector rows and4563 query descriptor rows, containing source row/sample identity and input-based bankindices/scores/support only; no true object/state/role/q-r before freeze.
prediction_fixed.barrier: Write+SHA freeze selector outputs/query scores before decoding target/fit/object_id and oldoracle-score metadata. Entry bindings/whole-NPZ opaque SHA may contain inert metadata; selected members only decoded.
prediction_fixed.reference_bank: Reuse exact V249 FIT-D bank unchanged. Already source-supervised statistics; do not call it unsupervised.

evaluation_fixed.late_join: After frozen predictions, read samples.fit/target, prototypes.object_id and existing V249 oracle DEV rows. Join exactly397 unique DEV(D340/E57), threeviews1191, verify row/sample/target/availability.
evaluation_fixed.reference_selection: Accuracy vs nominal teacher object on supported DEV queries; per D/E, old q-r strata and object. This is closed4bank selection, not native correctness or visibility accuracy.
evaluation_fixed.visibility_scores: E direction = negative selected-bank cosine and negative selected-minus-next margin. Both AUROCs/all3views always reported; no inversion, threshold, best-view, retraining or K/aggregator selection. Wrong cosine is distribution only.
evaluation_fixed.comparators: Auto supported outputs vs old oracle scores on the same supported rows, plus original fulloracle with original denominators. When chosenbank equals nominal target, cosine/margin must match oldoracle to abs1e-12. No artificially using correctbank on retrieval failures.
evaluation_fixed.support: Show selectorUNKNOWN/queryUNKNOWN counts and rate over original397, not successful abstention or relabelled truth. Keep all perobject empty classes NA.
evaluation_fixed.limitations: 4seen SOURCE classes, qGT-jitter emulation, repeated SourceDEV, E53of57 oneobject/twoscenes. Pallet native/Self unknown; no independent novelclass transfer or full deployment claim.

hard_limits.explicit_path_guard: Reject v112 case-insensitive/cache/.pyc/symlink before explicit access; no broadP/Rscan.
